module_summary: Wishbone clock-domain-crossing bridge: master-side registers capture a request, 3-flop synchronizers pass stb/cyc and done handshakes between domains, slave-side registers replay it and return the response.

anchors.name: wbm_stb_i_reg
anchors.why: Captured master strobe; marks pending request, synchronized into slave domain.

anchors.name: wbm_cyc_i_reg
anchors.why: Captured master cycle; holds request while slave side completes.

anchors.name: wbm_adr_i_reg
anchors.why: Holds request address across the clock-domain crossing.

anchors.name: wbm_dat_i_reg
anchors.why: Holds master write data until slave-side cycle starts.

anchors.name: wbm_we_i_reg
anchors.why: Holds master write-enable command for slave replay.

anchors.name: wbm_sel_i_reg
anchors.why: Holds master byte-select for slave replay.

anchors.name: wbm_dat_o_reg
anchors.why: Master-side read data latched from slave-domain response.

anchors.name: wbm_ack_o_reg
anchors.why: Master-side ack, set when done edge arrives from slave domain.

anchors.name: wbm_done_sync3
anchors.why: Done synchronizer chain into master domain; edge detect completes master cycle.

anchors.name: wbs_done_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side completion flag sent back to master domain.

anchors.name: wbs_stb_o_sync3
anchors.why: Stb synchronizer chain into slave domain; rising edge starts slave cycle.

anchors.name: wbs_cyc_o_sync3
anchors.why: Cyc synchronizer chain; falling edge clears slave-side registers.

anchors.name: wbs_stb_o_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side strobe register replaying master request.

anchors.name: wbs_cyc_o_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side cycle register driving wbs_cyc_o.

anchors.name: wbs_adr_o_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side address register loaded from master capture.

anchors.name: wbs_dat_o_reg
anchors.why: Slave-side write data register driving wbs_dat_o.

anchors.name: wbs_dat_i_reg
anchors.why: Captures slave read data at end of cycle for master return.

anchors.name: wbs_ack_i_reg
anchors.why: Latched slave ack status carried to master domain.

anchors.name: wbs_ack_i
anchors.why: Slave acknowledge ends slave cycle and latches response.

anchors.name: wbm_stb_i
anchors.why: Master strobe request captured in idle state.

groups.name: Master-side capture
groups.description: Latches master request, holds it, returns slave response and ack/err/rty.

groups.name: CDC synchronizers
groups.description: 3-flop synchronizers for stb/cyc to slave and done back to master.

groups.name: Slave-side replay
groups.description: Replays captured request on slave bus, captures slave response.
